name: Ransomware_Incident
description: Template for ransomware security incidents with standardized fields and tags
summary: Ransomware incident detected and automated response initiated

customFields.name: username
customFields.description: User account involved in the incident

customFields.name: src_ip
customFields.description: Source IP address of the threat actor

customFields.name: wazuh_alert_id
customFields.description: Wazuh alert ID that triggered the incident

customFields.name: wazuh_rule_id
customFields.description: Wazuh rule ID that generated the alert

customFields.name: detection_time
customFields.description: Timestamp when the ransomware was detected

customFields.name: shuffle_workflow_id
customFields.description: Shuffle workflow execution ID for automated response

customFields.name: misp_event_id
customFields.description: MISP event ID for threat intelligence correlation

customFields.name: kibana_dashboard
customFields.description: Kibana dashboard link for log analysis

customFields.name: containment_status
customFields.description: Current simulated containment status (pending/in_progress/completed). Real endpoint containment requires a real EDR/agent integration.

customFields.name: containment_action_id
customFields.description: Identifier of the simulated/documented containment action executed (e.g., network_isolation_001). Real endpoint containment is only simulated unless an external EDR enforces it.

customFields.name: containment_status_history
customFields.description: Comma-separated history of simulated containment status transitions (e.g., pending,in_progress,completed). Does not prove real containment on endpoints.

customFields.name: mitre_tactic_id
customFields.description: Primary MITRE ATT&CK tactic ID associated with the incident (e.g., TA0040)

customFields.name: affected_files
customFields.description: List of encrypted or affected files (comma-separated)

customFields.name: mitigation_actions
customFields.description: Actions taken to mitigate the incident

tasks.title: Wazuh Alert Validation
tasks.description: Validate Wazuh alert from SIEM and extract IoCs (hash, IP, hostname)

tasks.title: Shuffle Workflow Trigger
tasks.description: Shuffle automatically triggered by Wazuh webhook to execute response playbook

tasks.title: Create Case in TheHive
tasks.description: Create formal case with all observables and Wazuh alert details

tasks.title: Run Cortex Analyzers
tasks.description: Execute Cortex analyzers on hash, IP, and other IoCs for threat intelligence

tasks.title: MISP Correlation
tasks.description: Correlate IoCs with MISP threat intelligence database

tasks.title: Kibana Log Analysis
tasks.description: Review logs in Kibana dashboards for attack timeline and affected systems

tasks.title: Threat Intelligence Review
tasks.description: Review analyzer results, MISP correlations, and determine threat severity

tasks.title: Containment Decision
tasks.description: Decide on containment based on analysis (isolate endpoint, block IPs, quarantine)

tasks.title: Execute Containment Actions
tasks.description: Shuffle executes automated containment: isolate endpoint, block malicious IPs via firewall

tasks.title: Forensic Evidence Collection
tasks.description: Collect and preserve forensic evidence from affected systems

tasks.title: Security Team Notification
tasks.description: Notify security team and stakeholders via Shuffle notification workflow

tasks.title: Incident Documentation
tasks.description: Document all actions, timeline, and Shuffle workflow execution in TheHive

tasks.title: Recovery Planning
tasks.description: Plan system recovery, restore from backups, and verify containment
